description: Backend: add POST /api/tests/:id/submit scoring endpoint, GET /api/results and GET /api/results/:id endpoints, and a separate results router mounted in app.js. All per AGENTS.md §6 and §5.
steps: 1. Extend server/src/modules/aptitude/aptitude.schemas.js — add submitBodySchema (strict zod object): { answers: z.array(z.object({ questionId: objectIdSchema, selectedOption: z.number().int().min(0) }).strict()).max(200) }. Also add resultParamsSchema (reuse objectIdSchema for id). Export both.

2. Add evaluateSubmission(studentId, testId, answers) to server/src/modules/aptitude/aptitude.service.js. Steps: (a) load Test by testId — if missing throw AppError('TEST_NOT_FOUND'); (b) load questions with .select('+correctOption') from Question model, if 0 questions throw AppError('TEST_NOT_FOUND'); (c) validate: any questionId not in test → AppError('INVALID_SUBMISSION'), any duplicate questionId → AppError('INVALID_SUBMISSION'), any selectedOption >= question.options.length → AppError('INVALID_SUBMISSION'); (d) score: iterate all questions, if answered correctly add q.marks to score, totalMarks = sum of all q.marks; (e) percentage = totalMarks > 0 ? Math.round(score/totalMarks*100) : 0; (f) categoryScores: reduce questions into { [category]: {score, total} }, then map to sorted array [{ category, score, total }]; (g) await Result.create({ studentId, testId, score, totalMarks, percentage, categoryScores, submittedAt: new Date() }); (h) await recordActivity(studentId, 'TEST_COMPLETED', testId); (i) return { resultId: result._id.toString(), testId: testId.toString(), score, totalMarks, percentage, categoryScores }. NEVER include correctOption in any returned object.

3. Add listResults(studentId) to server/src/modules/aptitude/aptitude.service.js: find all Result docs where studentId matches, sort { submittedAt: -1 }, populate testId to get title. For each, return { resultId: r._id.toString(), testId: r.testId ? r.testId.toString() : null, testTitle: test found ? test.title : 'Test removed', score, totalMarks, percentage, submittedAt }. Use Result.find({ studentId }).sort({ submittedAt: -1 }) then do a separate Test.findById for each — OR use populate with lean. Prefer: lean + populate('testId', 'title') and handle missing (deleted) test by checking if populated field is null.

4. Add getResult(studentId, resultId) to server/src/modules/aptitude/aptitude.service.js: find Result by BOTH { _id: resultId, studentId } — if no match throw AppError('RESULT_NOT_FOUND'). Populate testId for title. Return { resultId, testId, testTitle (or 'Test removed'), score, totalMarks, percentage, categoryScores, submittedAt }.

5. Add three new controller handlers to server/src/modules/aptitude/aptitude.controller.js: submitTestHandler (calls evaluateSubmission, returns ok(res, data, 200)), listResultsHandler (calls listResults, returns ok(res, data)), getResultHandler (calls getResult, returns ok(res, data)).

6. Add POST /:id/submit route to server/src/modules/aptitude/aptitude.routes.js: authenticate, authorize('student'), validate({ params: aptitudeParamsSchema, body: submitBodySchema }), submitTestHandler.

7. Create server/src/modules/aptitude/results.routes.js: a new Express Router. Mount GET / with authenticate, authorize('student'), listResultsHandler. Mount GET /:id with authenticate, authorize('student'), validate({ params: resultParamsSchema }), getResultHandler. Export the router.
8. Register the results router in server/src/app.js: add apiRouter.use('/results', require('./modules/aptitude/results.routes')); after the /tests line. Do NOT re-register the aptitude tests router.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/tests/:id/submit with valid answers returns 200 with { resultId, testId, score, totalMarks, percentage, categoryScores } and response body never contains 'correctOption'.
POST /api/tests/:id/submit with unknown questionId returns 400 INVALID_SUBMISSION and creates no Result document.
POST /api/tests/:id/submit with duplicate questionId returns 400 INVALID_SUBMISSION and creates no Result document.
POST /api/tests/:id/submit with selectedOption out of range returns 400 INVALID_SUBMISSION and creates no Result document.
Each successful submit creates exactly one Result document and exactly one TEST_COMPLETED Activity document.
GET /api/results returns 200 with newest-first list showing correct testTitle (or 'Test removed' for deleted test).
GET /api/results/:id for caller's own result returns 200 with categoryScores.
GET /api/results/:id for another student's result returns 404 RESULT_NOT_FOUND.
npm --prefix server test passes all TC-TEST-03 and TC-TEST-04 describe blocks.
findings: All 7 backend steps implemented and passing. Key details for FEAT-002 (frontend): (1) POST /api/tests/:id/submit returns { success:true, data:{ resultId, testId, score, totalMarks, percentage, categoryScores } } — navigate to /results/:resultId after submit. (2) GET /api/results returns array with fields: resultId, testId, testTitle, score, totalMarks, percentage, submittedAt. (3) GET /api/results/:id returns: resultId, testId, testTitle, score, totalMarks, percentage, categoryScores:[{category,score,total}], submittedAt. (4) testsApi.js already has submitTest(id, answers) from S2-01 — only listResults() and getResult(id) need to be added. (5) ResultsPage.jsx and ResultDetailPage.jsx do not yet exist — they need to be created. (6) App.jsx may already have placeholder routes for /results and /results/:id — check before adding. (7) The full server test suite is 153 tests passing across 9 suites (commit 7ed5464 on branch feat/S2-02-scoring-results).
